description: Calculate sales tax / VAT for an order — a STATELESS quote that persists nothing (record it later with numeral_create_transaction using the returned calculation id). Returns per-jurisdiction rates, total_tax_amount, and totals. Provide a customer address and one or more line items (each needs reference_product_id OR product_category). Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit (cents). Numeral: POST /tax/calculations.

address_country.description: Country — a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "US").

address_province.description: State/province/region — a valid 2-letter ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. "CA").

address_type.description: Address type: "shipping" for physical goods, "billing" for software/digital goods.

id.description: A Numeral customer id (cus_...) for order tracking / exemptions.

customer_currency_code.description: Currency code. For API version 2024-09-01: "USD" or "CAD".

line_items.description: Order line items (one per product type).

amount.description: Line-item price in the currency's SMALLEST unit (e.g. USD 2000 = $20.00). Tax is calculated against this.

fallback_product_category.description: Fallback tax category used when reference_product_id has no matching product in Numeral.

product_category.description: A tax category from Numeral's taxonomy, e.g. "GENERAL_MERCHANDISE", "SAAS_GENERAL" (required if no reference_product_id).

quantity.description: Quantity of this product being sold.

reference_line_item_id.description: Your line-item id (optional; for record keeping).

reference_product_id.description: Your product id (required if no product_category).

tax_included_in_amount.description: Do the line-item amounts already include tax? Typically false for North America.

origin_address.description: The address a product ships from. Optional on 2024-09-01; required on API version 2025-05-12+.

address_country.description: Country — a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "US").

address_province.description: State/province/region — a valid 2-letter ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. "CA").

name: numeral_calculate_tax
title: Calculate tax
